import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the dynamic libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function

def ptlq_decomp(matrix):
    N = len(matrix)
    M = len(matrix[0])

    # Convert the input matrix to a ctypes array
    matrix_ctypes = (ctypes.c_double * (N * M))(*np.array(matrix).flatten())

    # Create GSL matrix
    gsl_matrix = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(N, M)
    gsl.gsl_matrix_set_all(gsl_matrix, matrix_ctypes)

    # Allocate other necessary GSL structures
    tau = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(min(M, N))
    p = gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc(N)
    signum = ctypes.c_int()
    norm = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(N)

    # Call the C function
    result = gsl.gsl_linalg_PTLQ_decomp(gsl_matrix, tau, p, ctypes.byref(signum), norm)

    if result != 0:
        raise RuntimeError('GSL function failed')

    # Extract results
    decomposed_matrix = np.array([gsl.gsl_matrix_get(gsl_matrix, i, j) for i in range(N) for j in range(M)]).reshape(N, M)
    tau_vector = np.array([gsl.gsl_vector_get(tau, i) for i in range(min(M, N))])
    permutation = np.array([gsl.gsl_permutation_get(p, i) for i in range(N)])
    norm_vector = np.array([gsl.gsl_vector_get(norm, i) for i in range(N)])

    # Free allocated memory
    gsl.gsl_matrix_free(gsl_matrix)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(tau)
    gsl.gsl_permutation_free(p)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(norm)

    return decomposed_matrix, tau_vector, permutation, signum.value, norm_vector

# Assertion tests

def assert_test():
    matrix = [[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]]
    decomposed_matrix, tau_vector, permutation, signum, norm_vector = ptlq_decomp(matrix)

    # Check the dimensions of the outputs
    assert decomposed_matrix.shape == (2, 2)
    assert tau_vector.shape == (2,)
    assert permutation.shape == (2,)
    assert isinstance(signum, int)
    assert norm_vector.shape == (2,)

    # Check some expected properties
    assert signum in [-1, 1]
    assert all(norm_vector >= 0)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
